title: 10. Tabular Customer Churn Analysis (Data Science Sim)
description:
You are given a list of user transaction records represented as dictionaries: `{'user_id': int, 'amount': float, 'days_active': int}`.

A user is categorized as 'High-Value Active' if `amount >= 100.0` and `days_active >= 30`.

Write a function `analyze_customers(records)` that returns a dictionary containing:
1. `'total_users'`: total number of unique user IDs.
2. `'high_value_count'`: number of distinct users who qualify as 'High-Value Active'.
3. `'high_value_pct'`: percentage of total users who are High-Value Active rounded to 2 decimal places (e.g. 25.0). Return 0.0 if total_users is 0.
constraints:
• 0 <= len(records) <= 10^4
• Optimal Time: O(N) single-pass | Optimal Space: O(U)
explanation: Simulates SQL `COUNT(DISTINCT user_id)` and conditional aggregation `CASE WHEN amount >= 100 AND days_active >= 30 THEN 1 END`. Using hash sets tracks distinct users in O(N) time and O(U) space.
